recentItems.title: Live: Rescuers push deeper into mudslide-hit area at China-Nepal border - Ep.2
recentItems.description:
Rescuers are pushing deeper into mudslide-hit areas near Gyirong Port in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, while excavators and loaders clear mud from a section of national highway G216. Damaged roads, harsh terrain, disrupted communications and the risk of secondary disasters continue to complicate the operation.
Follow CGTN for the latest updates.#CGTNOnSite

recentItems.title: What changed in 25 years? The SCO story in numbers
recentItems.description:
How much has the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) changed in 25 years? The answer lies in the numbers – from six founding members to a network of 27 members and partners. From trade and connectivity to security, healthcare and agriculture, these numbers reveal the scale of the SCO's transformation.

recentItems.title: Exclusive animation: Why rescue is difficult after Nepal glacier collapse triggers mudslide
recentItems.description:
An exclusive animation explains four major challenges facing rescuers after a devastating mudslide triggered by a high-altitude glacier collapse in Nepal struck Gyirong Port in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region on August 26.

The fast-moving debris flow traveled more than 20 kilometers and descended nearly 3,300 meters, leaving a vast search area, destroyed roads, steep terrain and severe constraints on aerial operations.

recentItems.title: Expert explains destructive power of ice-avalanche mudslides
recentItems.description:
What makes a mudslide triggered by an ice avalanche different from one caused by heavy rainfall or melting snow? Xu Qiang, president of Chengdu University of Technology, explains why such disasters can strike with little warning and enormous force.
